overview.heading: Overview
overview.p1: Elpuls ("Elpuls", "we", "us") is a mobile app for Swedish households that shows electricity spot prices, explains why they move using weather data, and suggests when to use electricity. Elpuls never controls or switches your electricity contract, and it never connects to or controls any smart-home device — all advice is informational, acted on manually by you.
overview.p2: This policy explains what personal data Elpuls collects, why, who it's shared with, how long it's kept, and the rights you have over it. It applies to the Elpuls mobile app and this website.

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: Elpuls is for adults only. You must be 18 or older to create an account and use the app. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If we learn that a user is under 18, we will close their account and delete their data.

transfers.heading: International Data Transfers
transfers.body: Firestore, our database, is hosted in the EU (Google Cloud's "eur3" multi-region, Belgium/Netherlands), so your account and profile data stays within the EU. The Cloud Functions that process requests — including reading an appliance or bill photo you upload — run in Google Cloud's "us-central1" region in the United States, and Anthropic's Claude API processes that data on its standard infrastructure, which is primarily US-based. Expo, which delivers push notifications, participates in the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) for its US-side processing — though the final delivery always goes through Apple's or Google's own push services (APNs/FCM), which have their own data protection terms. RevenueCat's own subprocessors (AWS, Elastic, and Sentry) are based in the USA, and RevenueCat relies on Standard Contractual Clauses (EU Decision 2021/914) as its transfer safeguard.

description.heading: Description of Service
description.body: Elpuls ("Elpuls", "we", "us") is a mobile app for Swedish households that shows electricity spot prices, explains why they move using weather data, and suggests when to use electricity. Elpuls is advisory only: it never switches your electricity contract, and it never connects to or controls any smart-home device or appliance. Every recommendation is information for you to act on manually.

eligibility.heading: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be 18 years of age or older to use Elpuls. The app asks you to confirm this during onboarding. If we learn that a user is under 18, we will close their account, consistent with our Privacy Policy.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.body: Elpuls works without creating an account — you're assigned an anonymous identifier automatically. You can optionally create an account with an email and password, which upgrades your existing anonymous identifier (so your data and subscription carry over) rather than starting fresh. You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure, and for all activity under your account.

subscription.heading: Elpuls Pro Subscription
subscription.body: Elpuls Pro is an optional paid subscription (currently 39 kr a month) that unlocks extra features. New subscribers get a 14-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID or Google account, and Elpuls never handles your payment details. The subscription renews automatically each month unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Refunds follow Apple's or Google's own refund policies.
subscription.eula: On iPhone, your use of the app is also covered by Apple's standard
subscription.eulaLink: Licensed Application End User License Agreement (EULA)

acceptableUse.heading: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to reverse-engineer, scrape, or interfere with Elpuls or its backend services, and not to use the app for any unlawful purpose. Elpuls is a convenience tool, not a substitute for professional financial, legal, or electrical-safety advice — use your own judgment, especially for decisions with real financial or safety consequences.

noDeviceControl.heading: No Device Control
noDeviceControl.body: Elpuls never connects to, controls, or automates any smart-home device, appliance, EV charger, or heating system. Every feature — including appliance recommendations, the heating plan, and the pre-use cost check — is advisory: Elpuls shows you information, and you decide what to do and act on it yourself, manually. Elpuls has no partnerships with, and makes no claims about, any specific hardware brand.

accuracy.heading: Accuracy Disclaimer
accuracy.body: Price data comes from elprisetjustnu.se (sourced from Nord Pool) and weather data from SMHI — both third parties Elpuls doesn't control. The AI-generated price explainer and other AI features are informational summaries, not guarantees. We work to keep this accurate, but Elpuls doesn't guarantee that any price, forecast, explanation, or savings estimate is complete, current, or error-free, and isn't liable for decisions made based on it.

ip.heading: Intellectual Property
ip.body: Elpuls, its name, logo, and app content belong to us. You keep ownership of the information you provide (like your appliance list or grid fee figures), and grant us the right to use it to operate the app for you, as described in our Privacy Policy.

termination.heading: Termination
termination.body: You can delete your account and all your data at any time from Settings → Account → Delete my account. We may suspend or terminate your access if you violate these terms. Deleting your account doesn't cancel an active Pro subscription — cancel that separately in the App Store or Play Store.

liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, Elpuls is provided "as is," and we aren't liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app, including any electricity costs, missed savings, or decisions made based on Elpuls' content. Nothing here limits liability that can't legally be excluded under Swedish or EU consumer protection law.
